objective: Close the broad program's open middle with a lawful same-unit longitudinal route linking a dated or recalled material/health event to alternatives or adaptation, money/time trade-off, later outcome, and—where the source supports it—meaning, trust, action, or exit.
current_boundary: No PSID, UAS, HRS, or MEPS staged respondent file required for the next gated pass is currently present locally. A fresh read-only workspace inventory on 2026-10-19 found route pages, logs, access manifests, scripts, derived records, and compiled test artifacts, but no newly supplied respondent archive or raw wave file in the checked data formats. The official PSID route remains account-controlled, with no local microdata. The official UAS pages currently describe the Older Ages Monthly Event Panel Dataset and the June 2026 Comprehensive Panel Dataset as registration-required downloads, with public documentation but gated respondent data; no authorized file is present. Public documentation and field manifests are not treated as microdata evidence.

newly_closed_or_strengthened: Public SIPP person-month records now support an adjacent same-person bridge from SNAP participation and reported transition reason to next-month income-to-poverty and hardship measures.
Public SIPP records also support a same-person descriptive bridge from stable SNAP status to paid child-care use, child-care assistance, and care arrangements that prevent work or additional work.
These bridges strengthen the material and care/work-capacity middle of the broad program without requiring an unsupported causal claim.
still_open: dated notice, application effort, benefit amount, timing, appeal, and verified remedy receipt
whether care was actually obtained, adequate, affordable, and sustained
later household security, trust, action, switching, or exit
public_bridge_progress.interpretation: The public SIPP bridges are real same-person progress, but they are not a complete recovery episode. SNAP participation, care assistance, or a work constraint must not be treated as proof of security or restored capacity.
public_bridge_progress.next_authorized_need: An account-authorized UAS Older Ages, PSID, HRS, or equivalent episode-compatible file remains necessary to close the remaining middle and test later durability, meaning, trust, action, or exit.

meps_public_comparator_progress.current_evidence: Retained MEPS 2024 records join month-ordered office, emergency-room, and inpatient event families to round-level payment, health, employment, bill context, and a strict-window same-person R5/3 follow-up.
what_it_closes: person/event linkage and compatible time ordering
descriptive later health and employment transitions
coverage-conditioned payment context across observed care events
what_remains_open: event-specific initiating need, payer, and feasible alternative
claim, appeal, correction, or remedy receipt
household adaptation, adequacy, trust, action, switching, or exit
meps_public_comparator_progress.promotion_boundary: The MEPS comparator strengthens the public same-person bridge but cannot substitute for an authorized event-first longitudinal file or be promoted as a complete recovery episode.

promotion_gate.rule: Do not promote an end-to-end finding when a required field is absent, only round-level context, or inferred across different units. Preserve unknown and structurally missing states.

ranked_routes.route: UAS Older Ages Monthly Events first pass
ranked_routes.why: Smallest documented event-first route: one uasid-by-wave row, prior-month event timing, medical expenditures, work/earnings, health, pain, and life satisfaction for adults 50+.
stop_if: stable key or wave timing fails
event fields do not overlap later outcomes
weights or missingness cannot be interpreted

ranked_routes.why: Largest planned many-family bridge for material room, paid work, unpaid care, time pressure, health, wellbeing, persistence, and reversal; it is not a dated remedy episode by itself.
stop_if: Conditions of Use are not accepted
valid denominators or variance method are unavailable

ranked_routes.why: The June 2026 CPD is now explicitly documented as a registered-user, respondent-by-wave, harmonized backbone for health, financial, employment, and wellbeing fields; add 537/698 only after the event-first structure and CPD linkage pass.
required_inputs: UAS 537 and/or UAS 698 only if overlap and terms permit

storage_and_authority: Use only account-authorized files supplied for this pass. Do not download large archives by default, do not bypass login or terms, do not process UAS files without express written authorization, and retain hashes, field manifests, audit outputs, and compact derived records rather than raw respondent files.
handoff_result: The next turn with authorized files begins with structural and access checks, not estimation. If no authorized files are supplied, preserve this as an open acquisition boundary and continue only with bounded public comparators. The current PSID route recheck confirms that no authenticated extract is present, and the current UAS pages confirm registration-required access; do not repeat unauthenticated download attempts. Public SIPP care/work bridges are now part of the retained progress, but they do not replace the authorized longitudinal pass.
